name: The Broken World
description: Apocalypse World's own core rulebook deliberately ships with NO canonical setting at all — the game's entire first-session structure exists to have the MC and players build their specific apocalypse together at the table (near or far past the apocalypse, what broke, what a hardhold looks like, what the psychic maelstrom does). This Setting is a single, honestly-labeled EXAMPLE built in that same spirit — a hardhold clinging to a water source, gangs trading barter and favors across a cratered, maelstrom-touched wasteland — not official canon, because there isn't any. Reskin freely; that's the point of the game.
